tip.en: At 0.7 km on dead-flat terrain, HR jumps from 144 to 158 in roughly 9 seconds with no pace change — this sudden uncoupling of effort and cardiac load is the first sign something is off. Worth noting whether you felt any chest tightness or simply a rush of adrenaline here.
tip.zh: 0.7公里处地形完全平坦，心率却在约9秒内从144骤升至158，配速没有变化。这种用力感与心脏负荷的突然脱节是异常的第一个信号，值得回想这里是否有胸闷或肾上腺素飙升的感觉。

tip.en: HR reaches 189 — 20 bpm above your recent 8-run ceiling of 169 — at a modest 5:23 pace on pancake-flat ground around 1.3 km. Your recent history shows no run has approached this. This is not a sprint, not a climb; flag this for a cardiac review if it recurs.
tip.zh: 心率达到189次，比你近8次跑步的最高值169高出整整20次，而此时配速只有5:23，地形完全平坦。这不是冲刺也不是爬坡，请留意后续是否重现，必要时建议做心电检查。

tip.en: HR collapses from 185 to 143 between idx 534 and 540 — a 30-bpm drop in roughly 3 seconds with no corresponding pace change. This kind of instantaneous reset on flat terrain is not normal cardiovascular recovery; it most likely signals an arrhythmic episode or sensor artifact. If you felt a flutter or sudden lightheadedness here, take it seriously.
tip.zh: 心率在约3秒内从185骤降至143，配速未变、地形平坦。这种瞬间重置在正常心血管恢复中不会出现，很可能是心律失常发作或传感器故障。如果当时感到心悸或一过性头晕，请认真对待。

title.zh: 心率归零，身体继续前行

tip.en: By 1.8 km HR has settled to 136 — below your session average — and pace is unchanged at ~6:00. The fact that you ran through the spike without stopping shows composure, but this 20-minute stretch of suppressed HR after a near-max event is unusual and worth monitoring.
tip.zh: 1.8公里处心率已回落至136，低于全程均值，配速依旧稳定在约6:00。你没有停下来继续跑完说明状态稳定，但在接近最大心率事件后出现如此长时间的低心率区间是不寻常的，建议持续关注。

title.zh: 折返点附近配速明显停滞

tip.en: A 10:33 pace blip appears at 4.9 km — likely a brief stop or traffic pause — and the surrounding 500 m from 4.8–5.0 km shows the slowest sustained pacing of the run (7:00–9:03 range). HR is a stable 145, so this is a physical interruption, not fatigue. It marks the quiet nadir before the return leg picks up.
tip.zh: 4.9公里处出现10:33的配速低谷，前后500米（4.8–5.0公里）是全程持续配速最慢的片段（7:00–9:03），但心率稳定在145。这是外部干扰而非疲劳，也标志着回程提速前最平静的时刻。

tip.en: From 5.9 km onward HR climbs steadily from 149 to 157 and pace sharpens to the 4:30–5:10 range — the most sustained quality running of the entire session. After the chaotic first half, finishing with controlled intensity on the same flat corridor is a strong positive to build on.
tip.zh: 从5.9公里开始，心率稳步从149升至157，配速提升至4:30–5:10区间，是全程质量最高的持续跑段。在前半段心率异常的背景下，能在同一平坦路段以有控制的强度收尾，是值得巩固的积极信号。
